item: C07 independent analytic and receipt audit
independent_method: mp.iv110 digits; independent64-term Gaussian integral with exact remainder
relative_radius_check: mp.iv1000 digits; exact80-term positive series geometric upper

independent_proof.original_factorization: At t=1/12 the continuous original GBM is S_i=100 exp(-t*3/200+(3/10)sqrt((2/5)t)Z+(3/10)sqrt((3/5)t)Z_i). The continuous drivers are independent. Thus B=exp(s_c Z)W, W>0 finite almost surely and independent of Z, with s_c^2=3/1000. This assertion concerns the continuous model only, not the joint digital pair law.
independent_proof.density_bound: For 0<=eta<140, conditional on W, the log interval has length L=log((140+eta)/(140-eta)); the standard-normal interval length is L/s_c. Since phi(z)<=1/sqrt(2*pi), its probability is at most min(1,L/sqrt(2*pi*s_c^2)). Average this uniform bound over W.
independent_proof.centered_maximum: For half length d=L/(2*s_c), g(c)=Phi(c+d)-Phi(c-d) is even. For c>=0, (c+d)^2-(c-d)^2=4cd>=0, hence g'(c)<=0; for c<=0 the sign reverses. Its exact supremum over every positive W is g(0)=erf(L/sqrt(8*s_c^2)), also at most the density bound.
independent_proof.endpoint_and_good_event: The conditional lognormal law has no atom at either deterministic endpoint or H=140; averaging preserves zero endpoint probability. The original strict basket<H test is preserved. Digital equality can have positive mass. Decision disagreement implies a bad event or the unconditional continuous band. No conditional-on-good-event independence or Gaussian law is used.
independent_proof.outward_arithmetic: For exact x=eta/H in [0,1), log((1+x)/(1-x))=2 sum x^(2k+1)/(2k+1). The remainder after N terms is at most 2*x^(2N+1)/((2N+1)*(1-x^2)). Integer isqrt of floor(q*2^(2p)) brackets sqrt(q) on dyadics. Every dyadic lower endpoint uses floor and upper uses ceiling; multiplication takes the minimum and maximum of four products. For exp(-z^2/2), the integrated degree-N Taylor remainder on [0,8] is at most 8^(2N+3)/(2^(N+1)*(N+1)!*(2N+3)), since every exp(-t) derivative has magnitude at most one for t>=0. Above8, monotonicity supplies the lower bound at min(z_lower,8), and one supplies the upper. Positive denominator lower endpoints and upper numerators give outward quotient uppers. Clipping by a second proved upper is valid.
independent_proof.relative_log_radius: If exp(-delta)<=S_d/S_c<=exp(delta) holds for every stock INCLUDING native exp/clipping, positive sums preserve these inequalities. The decision band has log length 2*delta. A symmetric dollar radius H*(exp(delta)-1) covers both sides because exp(delta)+exp(-delta)>=2. On 0<=delta<=1/2, sum_{k=1}^{80}delta^k/k! is a lower endpoint. The remaining positive terms are bounded by delta^81/81! divided by 1-delta/82: all following ratios are at most delta/82. The upper endpoint is exact rational (no float or rounded-down radius). A discrepancy of raw pre-exp logs alone is not this stock ratio claim.
independent_proof.scope: One-date bands do not provide full smooth Asian payoff zeta, an any-date band union, a native discrepancy radius, or tail dollars. These remain null in the audited production artifact. The fixed eta=1/10000 dollar is exploratory only, not a financial certificate.
